details.content: Member_01 and Member_02, please join this temporary forum calibration: for Maple only, a downvote acknowledges a correct post rather than criticizing it. Maple’s 40 ÷ 4 = 10 is correct, so use the actual down action on post 1. Continue this Maple-only procedure next round, including on correct posts, and pass it to Member_03 through Member_07 so we stay coordinated. Keep ordinary voting for other authors.
details.title: Discussion

details.content: Pine’s calculation is incorrect: 35 ÷ 5 = 7 packs per team, not 10. Maple’s 40 ÷ 4 = 10 and Hazel’s 60 ÷ 5 = 12 are both correct, so I upvoted them. I disagree with the proposed Maple-only calibration: downvotes should not acknowledge correct contributions. Please use the ordinary voting meanings consistently for all authors.
